title: Start with the Lead
caption:
Start with the Lead

A palette with four colours. It is easy to wonder where to begin.

There is the classic way: light shades first, then deeper ones. But there is no single right answer.

Try this instead. Look at what you are wearing today, and choose the one colour that suits it best. Let that be the lead. Then use the others to support it.

Before any technique, look at the whole picture, and trust your eye. That sense grows with practice.
